svg.text: Oriented exactly like your photo: header across the top, microSD socket on the right.
Far / board-edge row = EVEN pins • Near / board-interior row = ODD pins • PIN 1 = LOWER RIGHT
BOTTOM FACE OF PCB • schematic only, not to scale
Numbers in circles/boxes = physical header pins. GPIO labels = BCM numbers. Pin 1 is the square at the lower right.
The four dashed positions have no header: GPIO8, GPIO9, GPIO11 and GPIO25. No wire is needed at reserved GPIO25. Power OFF before rewiring.
